candidate_selection_rule: From restricted frontiers only, retain candidates whose total visible-evidence characters are at most 75% or at most 50% of always-expand, whose deterministic retrieval-action count is at most 3, and whose offline semantic-reference-potential gap from always-expand is at most 2.0 percentage points. If multiple remain, select the smallest total-character candidate; ties use lexicographic frontier name. Any selected item is diagnostic only and is not a method result.
paired_analysis_unit: question_uid, paired across always-expand and the candidate frontier on the same 506 qualified questions; the one predeclared NOT_MODEL_READY hidden-scale question is excluded before output
receipt_scope: P2 deterministic evidence recompute; no generation, judge, training, production or database call is authorized
